recipes.name: Campbell's Broccoli Rice Casserole
ingredients_raw: 1.5 cups cooked regular long-grain white rice
1 (10.5 ounce) can Campbell's® Condensed Cream of Chicken Soup (Regular or 98% Fat Free)
1 (8 fl oz) jar pasteurized process cheese sauce (like Cheez Whiz®)

steps.text: Gather the ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Heat butter in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook until tender-crisp, stirring occasionally.
Add broccoli to the skillet and cook until it's tender-crisp, stirring occasionally.
Stir in rice, condensed soup, cheese sauce, and milk. Cook and stir until cheese is melted.
Pour broccoli-rice mixture into a 2-quart shallow baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until the mixture is hot and bubbling, about 30 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Campbell's Broccoli Rice Casserole
raw_recipe.description: This quick-cooking broccoli, cheese, and rice casserole is comforting and easy to make with a delicious, creamy sauce to bring everything together.

review.reviewBody: I have made this recipe so many times and have received so many compliments BUT I have to adjust a few things. First off- no no no processed cheese! I use 2 cups or Sharp Cheddar Cheese. Then I use 1 can Cream of Chicken Soup and 1 can Cream of Mushroom. Believe me- with these changes this is a 5 star recipe.

I made this today, using some leftover plain white rice, two large fresh broccoli crowns, and a bag of frozen onions. Aprx. 2 cups. I think this is a wonderful base recipe, and I definitely varied it, but it was excellent, smooth, creamy, and beautiful to look at as well. I kept the Cheez Whiz at the same amount, but added two tablespoons or so of cream cheese, plus two cups of a finely shredded cheddar-quesadero cheese blend. I ended up with a LOT more than 16oz of broccoli (which I sautéed with the onions, after letting them cook down a bit), so I knew right away that I needed to bump up the ingredients. I added both crm of chicken and mushroom (one of each), plenty of freshly ground pepper, about a teaspoon and 1/2 of paprika, garlic powder to taste, and about 1/2 tsp of red pepper flakes. I also increased the milk to abt 2/3 cup, and I topped the casserole with the final 1/2 cup of shredded cheese blend, then layered the PLAIN, UNSALTED white rice at the bottom, then the broccoli mixture, more rice, and topped it with the remaining cheese blend. I kept the baking time at 30 minutes. It is important to note—No additional salt was added, as there is PLENTY with the cheeses and soups. This was so good! A wonderful use of leftover rice, and the fresh broccoli cooked beautifully. I will make this exactly the same way next time!

To make this even easier, I made some changes and it turned out great. Used frozen Jasmine rice instead of making the rice, and add rotisserie/pre-shredded chicken I had on hand. I steamed fresh broccoli in a covered bowl in the microwave for 3 minutes, then added that, the rice, chicken, Campbells cream of chicken soup, butter, a dash of heavy cream (instead of milk) and shredded cheddar (instead of processed cheese) directly to a baking dish and mixed before baking. Okay, maybe I changed a lot! But it's a great basic recipe.

This was so good, even my 3 picky children all liked it!!! I simplified the steps and combined the cheese whiz, cream of chicken soup, milk and 2 cups uncooked rice together and added in a can of chicken broth. I steamed the broccoli (used 2 bags instead of 1) in the microwave for a couple of minutes (don't know if this was necessary but wanted to make sure it was tender in the end) and then added it along with some shredded chicken to the soup mixture. I added a little shredded cheddar cheese (because we like ours cheesy) and a little salt, pepper and garlic powder for flavoring. Put it all in a casserole dish and sliced about 1/2 a stick of butter and spread it out on top. Baked in the oven covered for about 45 minutes and then took the foil off for the last 15 minutes. Let it set for a while to cool- it will be very hot. Wonderful dish you can make ahead and then just pop in the oven for days you don't have much time, and if you add some meat it's a complete meal!

Based on other comments I made a few changes; I added a can of chicken and added it while softening the onions in the butter, used a can of cream of chicken and a can of cream of mushroom, used 1 cup of grated cheddar cheese and 1 cup of Dubliner cheese (because I had it on hand), and I used however much rice I had cooked from one cup dry rice. I topped the casserole with additional cheddar and Dubliner. It filled a 9x13 pan. I baked about 25 minutes and broiled a few minutes to brown the cheese. It was delicious and turned out to be a very filling and easy meal.

I was looking for a recipe similar to my great grandmothers version of this dish. This one was pretty darn close. :)
I cook to feed 5 people, with leftovers, so I doubled this recipe to make a deep 9x13 casserole dish. I made 2 substitutions. I did 50/50 cream of chicken/cream of mushroom, and we don't eat processed cheese so I shredded about 4 to 5 cups of Medium Cheddar and used that. I mixed about 1.5 cups into the mixture before baking and topped it w the rest. I also did a little additional seasoning in it with some black pepper and garlic.

This is absolutely one of my favorite side dishes! I make it every Thanksgiving and my family looks forward to it every year. I sautee onion and celery together and I add garlic salt and pepper and instead of the whole jar of cheez whiz I only use half of it. I also add a small can of evaporated milk. It's perfect! I also don't mix it all together. In a casserole dish I put the rice in, pat it down and just pour the sauce mixture on top and bake until bubbly.....it's absolutely delicious! :)

This is a great starter recipe. I substitute about 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese for the processed cheese sauce. Using real cheese, you'll need to up the milk too. To easily make this a main course I add either cooked chopped ham or chicken. I also add some garlic powder to add a little extra flavor.

Creativity goes a long way with this recipe! I knew when I read the recipe that I would use real cheese instead of cheese whiz(yuck). I used a blend of white and sharp cheddar with a little colby as well. About a cup and a half. Also, I used my common sense to realize that 1/3 cup of milk was not gonna cook all that rice. Follow the directions on the can of soup (1 can of soup plus one can of water) If you're making the dish in a large casserole dish like I did, just add a little more rice and cheese to feed up to 8 people. I also had some roast chicken leftover so I added that as well and topped it off with some cheese. It was delicious. Entire meal in one dish. *Be careful with your seasonings.*

I modified this a bit and used 8 oz of freshly shredded cheese and 1 lb of fresh broccoli. I also added a light dusting of bread crumbs to the top before baking. The dish turned out delicious but the amount of butter the recipe called for was way too much. Next time I'll probably use half as much butter. Just seeing the excess butter run off of the food on my plate was gross. I would also add salt and pepper to taste.

Made it, hate to use Velveeta or creamy American cheese since it's processed, but . . . still do love it and so does everyone! We never cook anything ahead of time, except heating broccoli so it's not frozen and cook longer in oven - 45 minutes at 400 or so and the rice and all cook just fine - we love it!!!!
Great flavor. I used 1 can each of mushroom and chicken soup. Also shredded cheddar cheese. I’m not a rice person, but I loved it this way!
Been making this for 40 years. Never fails.
Used real cheese. Added shrimp and a little hot sauce. Perfect
I love this dish...everyone in my family loves it. I use Velveeta cut i to small cubes I stead of cheese sauce
I have made this recipe for over 20 years! Everyone looks forward to this side dish during thanks giving
Perfect for Thanksgiving and wonderful side dish !
I LOVED IT!
Great recipe, bur I change it by adding cauliflower as well as broccoli and also chicken breast. It is a good main course casserole.
I didnt have cheez wiz so used a small velveeta. I also added more seasoning (Spike). Im not a fan of rice but this is a keeper. My whole family loves this.
